updates.refresh_cua_driver.description: Refresh an installed cua-driver during `hermes update` (best-effort, macOS only). Turn off e.g. on non-admin accounts where /Applications isn't writable.

vault.description: External secret sources — pull credentials from secret managers at startup instead of storing them in ~/.hermes/.env. Browser credential vault: which login sources browser_vault may draw from. The local encrypted vault (`hermes vault add`, Desktop → Settings → Credential Vault) is always on. External password managers are unlocked per session with a masked master-password prompt; headless sessions (cron, webhook, API) never prompt and see them as locked.

vault.bitwarden.binary_path.description: absolute path to bw; empty = PATH.

vault.bitwarden.enabled.description: `bw` CLI (Password Manager, not Secrets Manager); run `bw login` once first.

vault.key_storage.description: NEW vault's key: file (0600 vault.key) | keychain (OS; file if none). See `hermes vault key`.

vault.onepassword.account.description: account shorthand for `op --account`; empty = default account.

vault.onepassword.binary_path.description: absolute path to op; empty = PATH.

vault.onepassword.enabled.description: detected managers are login sources unless the user opts out (enabled: false) `op` CLI: Login items with a website URL become fillable handles.

vault.onepassword.service_account_token_.description: Env var holding a service-account token (headless auth, no unlock prompt). Unset = prompt.

vertex.description: Google Vertex AI (Gemini). Auth is OAuth2 from a service-account JSON or ADC, NOT an API key; the credential path lives in .env (VERTEX_CREDENTIALS_PATH / GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS). Bridged to VERTEX_PROJECT_ID / VERTEX_REGION.

vertex.project_id.description: GCP project ID. Empty → project_id from the service-account JSON (or ADC).

vertex.region.description: "global" is required for Gemini 3.x preview models (regional endpoints silently 404); use e.g. "us-central1" only if your models are region-pinned.

vision.description: Native images (vision_analyze, browser screenshots, replayed user images) are re-sent on every later call.

vision.embed_target_bytes.description: Byte budget for one embedded image (clamped 64 KiB..4 MiB). Raise it for dense phone screenshots of tables the model calls "unreadable" at 256 KB.

vision.max_calls_per_image.description: How often vision_analyze may embed the SAME image (region crops included) per session. null = 3 inside delegated subagents (they run unattended), unlimited for the main agent; an explicit number applies everywhere; 0 = unlimited.

vision.replay_recent_images.description: newest user images re-sent on turns rebuilt from state.db; 0 = off

voice.barge_in.description: interrupt the agent / stop TTS when the user starts talking

voice.barge_in_grace_seconds.description: Trip suppression after TTS onset (mic stays live the whole turn).

voice.barge_in_threshold_multiplier.description: Speech trigger = quiet-room floor x this (floor calibrated BEFORE playback).

voice.beep_enabled.description: record start/stop beeps in CLI voice mode

voice.client_direct.description: Desktop remote clients call STT/TTS providers DIRECTLY (config + key fetched over authenticated REST at session start) instead of relaying via the gateway.

voice.gpt_live.instructions.description: Extra sentences appended to the live model's conversation persona (tone, pacing, language).

voice.gpt_live.voice.description: marin | quartz | ripple | vesper | willow | stone | gleam | meridian | ...

voice.stop_phrases.description: Saying EXACTLY one of these (case-insensitive, punctuation ignored) ends the voice chat instead of going to the agent. [] disables.

voice.submit_mode.description: TUI: direct submits immediately; draft = editable transcript

voice.thinking_sound.description: ambient bubble sound while the agent works (volume = beep_volume)

voice.voice_chat_mode.description: How the Desktop voice conversation is wired: chained  — STT → Hermes turn → TTS (the stt.* / tts.* providers below) gpt-live — one full-duplex voice model (OpenAI GPT-Live) owns the mic and speaker and DELEGATES every real request to Hermes (any model / provider you have selected); needs an OpenAI API key. $0.05/min voice layer billing.

wake_word.description: "Hey Hermes" hands-free wake word: always-on, on-device hotword detection that starts a fresh voice session. Off by default; toggle with /wake.

wake_word.capture.description: auto | local | client (desktop streams mic via wake.feed)

wake_word.confirmation_frames.description: openWakeWord/pyopen-wakeword only: consecutive over-threshold frames to fire (higher = fewer false triggers, more latency; 1 = single-frame)

web.cache_enabled.description: TTL caching for web_search + web_extract: repeat searches (same query + provider) within the TTL come from an in-process memo; repeat extracts from the cache/web store. Concurrent identical searches coalesce into one vendor request. Only successes cached.

web.cache_exempt_hosts.description: Hosts always fetched live, never from the extract cache (staging deploys, tunnel URLs, preview builds). Entries match exactly, as "*.wildcard", or as a domain suffix ("mysite.dev" also covers "preview.mysite.dev"). localhost/private IPs always exempt.

web.extract_char_limit.description: per-page char budget for web_extract; larger pages truncate, full text kept in cache/web

web.keyless_fallback.description: Keyless free-tier ring: with NO web backend configured or keyed, web_search/web_extract rotate round-robin across exa, parallel, firecrawl, keenable public free tiers, failing over on rate limits. Never pre-empts a configured/keyed backend. false = disable.

web.keyless_rescue.description: One-shot rescue: when the chosen/keyed backend fails a call, THAT call retries once on the keyless ring; the next call tries the chosen backend again (no sticky failover). Off when keyless_fallback is false.

web.provider_tier.description: Per-vendor tier for vendors with both a keyless free endpoint and a keyed paid path (exa, parallel, firecrawl, keenable; tavily is opt-in keyless via `hermes tools`, not a ring member). Set by the `hermes tools` picker. "free" = always anonymous endpoint even with a key; "paid" = always keyed (missing key = error; vendor excluded from the ring); unset = keyed when the key is present, else the ring.

worktrees.description: Stale git worktree lifecycle (`hermes -w`, `/worktree new`, subagent isolation, Desktop). The sweep runs at `hermes -w` startup and every 6h from the cron ticker over every repo Hermes made a worktree in. worktrees.archive_max_file_mb.description: Untracked files larger than this (MB) are not archived, so a tree holding one is kept.

worktrees.archive_retention_days.description: The sweep deletes archive refs older than this many days. 0 keeps them forever.

worktrees.max_total_gb.description: Optional size budget (GB) for idle trees: past it the oldest idle trees are archived and removed first. Live, young and Kanban trees are never counted or touched. 0 = off.
